acip: DE LTA NA YANG GNYUG SEMS DE TSUL MIN YID BYED SOGS KYI RKYEN GYIS CHAGS SOGS DRI MA DANG LHAN CIG GNAS PA'I TSE, RANG LA YOD BZHIN DU BYIS PA RNAMS LA MNGON SUM DU MI 'GYUR BA NI, CHAGS SOGS DRI MAS BSGRIBS NAS MA MTHONG BA YIN ZHING,
wylie: de lta na yang gnyug sems de tshul min yid byed sogs kyi rkyen gyis chags sogs dri ma dang lhan cig gnas pa'i tshe, rang la yod bzhin du byis pa rnams la mngon sum du mi 'gyur ba ni, chags sogs dri mas bsgribs nas ma mthong ba yin zhing
english: The primordial mind is pure like this, yet when--due to factors such as regarding things in the wrong way--it exists alongside those impurities such as our attachment, it is not perceived this way.  Even though it belongs to us, manifest and unchanging, as children we cannot see it, because it is obscured by the stench of our craving and the like.
